subject: Mutual Action Plan — signature & procurement cutoff alignment
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps & owners)

Thanks again for taking the call today, Sophie — great to hear more about BrightLayer's security gating and procurement windows. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the milestones we agreed on, suggested owners, and a target signature window. Highlights: 

- Target signature: week of Aug 9 (we proposed Aug 12 as a working date)
- Procurement/PO needed by: Aug 2 to meet internal cycle at BrightLayer (as mentioned on call)
- Milestones: technical validation (BrightLayer PM), security review (BrightLayer infosec), legal review (both sides), final contract signing
- Suggested owners: BrightLayer PM (S. Grant), BrightLayer Legal (T. Ellis), Redwood CS lead (Marissa), Redwood Legal (Rishi)

Please review the attached BL_MAP_v1.2.docx and the SOW draft (redwood-sow-draft.pdf). If the dates above look off, flag them here and we can adjust. I also included a link to the live MAP doc for collaborative edits: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB_MAP_draft_BL-742

Next steps I committed to on the call:
- I will circulate the MAP and a short list of open dependencies by tomorrow (Jul 14).
- Marissa will take the technical validation checklist and propose time slots next week for an intake demo.
- Rishi will prepare a short note on expected legal review timeframes for an enterprise SOW.

Appreciate your time — looking forward to getting the procurement window locked so we can hit the August target.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BL_MAP_v1.2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), redwood-sow-draft.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@brightlayer.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@brightlayer.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps & owners)

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications from BrightLayer's side after reviewing internally: 

1) Procurement window: Our finance org just confirmed that for August signature, we need the PO issued no later than Aug 1 (not Aug 2) due to an accounting cutoff for vendor onboarding. That means legal needs our signed SOW by Jul 28 to route for PO creation.

2) Legal review: Tom (cc'd) and I estimate our legal can turn around a standard SOW in ~5 business days, but any substantive redlines could add another week. Is there flexibility on Redwood's side to accept a soft signature (e-sign pending PO) to start some onboarding prep?

3) Responsibility ask: can Redwood own the onboarding checklist completion for the first week post-signature (so our infra team can schedule capacity ahead of time)?

We'd like the MAP to reflect: PO cutoff Aug 1, target signature Jul 30 (so we have buffer). Can you confirm owners and whether Redwood can support a preliminary onboarding run before PO? 

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Grant
Senior PM, Partnerships
BrightLayer
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@brightlayer.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps & owners)

Appreciate the detail, Sophie. Quick responses inline and proposed MAP adjustments below.

- PO cutoff: noted — change map PO deadline to 2026-08-01.
- Target signature: we'll mark provisional target as 2026-07-30 (hard target 2026-08-02 only if PO timeline shifts).
- Legal turnaround: Rishi, pls confirm if 5 business days is feasible from our side for a standard SOW. If Rishi needs more, we'll note an action for expediting.

Onboarding-before-PO: We can run a limited "pre-onboarding" sequence (non-prod access, onboarding checklist execution, kick-off call) contingent on a signed MOU or mutually-executed letter of intent (LOI) that confirms commercial terms and indemnities. If BrightLayer is comfortable with a short LOI that states: "begin onboarding activities pending final SOW and PO with no charge until PO is issued," Redwood legal can accept and start preparatory work.

Proposed MAP milestone updates (high level):
- Jul 16–23: Technical intake + demo (owner: Marissa Cole)
- Jul 20–28: Legal review cycle (owner: Rishi Malhotra — target 5 business days)
- Jul 26–30: Final internal approvals at BrightLayer (owner: Sophie Grant)
- Jul 30: Target signature (owner: both legal teams)
- Aug 1: PO cutoff date for BrightLayer finance
- Aug 2–9: Onboarding prep/run (owner: Marissa Cole)

I've updated the Google MAP doc and attached BL_MAP_v1.2_redlined.docx with the date changes and the LOI option. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB_MAP_draft_BL-742

Rishi — can you confirm by EOD Friday (Jul 16) whether Redwood can commit to a 5 business day legal turnaround for the current SOW language? If not, flag specific sections that would require extended review.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BL_MAP_v1.2_redlined.docx (changes tracked)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@brightlayer.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps & owners)

Quick note on legal timing — for the SOW as-is our estimate is 4 business days for a standard review (confirming no unusual indemnity/data residency asks). Two items that could extend review: (1) any customer-requested changes to data retention beyond our standard 90-day cache policy; (2) changes to the liability cap. If BrightLayer is okay with our standard retention clause and the SOW liability cap, 4 business days is doable.

On the LOI: legal is comfortable drafting a short LOI that permits preliminary onboarding activities (non-prod only) pending finalized SOW and PO, with a clause that services become billable only upon PO receipt. We will draft LOI and share a one-page version by Mon, Jul 19.

Rishi Malhotra
Lead Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@brightlayer.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: MAP update & confirmation of next steps (signature timeline locked)

Hi Sophie / Tom — circling back with an updated MAP and clear next steps after internal alignment. Summary of what we locked: 

- LOI: Redwood will send one-page LOI (Rishi to share by Mon Jul 19) to enable limited non-prod onboarding prior to PO.
- Legal: Redwood legal confirms 4 business day turnaround for the current SOW language (Rishi).
- Target signature: Jul 30, 2026 (provisional). BrightLayer PO cutoff: Aug 1, 2026.
- Owners: BrightLayer approvals (Sophie / Tom); Redwood onboarding and CS (Marissa / Neha); Redwood legal (Rishi); AE owner (Karthik).
- Dependencies: final acceptance of standard retention clause & liability cap; confirmation that LOI form is acceptable to BrightLayer procurement.

Action items: 
- Rishi: draft and share LOI by Jul 19 (in progress).
- Sophie: confirm LOI acceptance and internal routing timeframe by Jul 21.
- Marissa/Neha: schedule intake demo and onboarding slots for Jul 20–23 (Marissa to propose times).
- Karthik: update HubSpot with MAP changes and push calendar invites for the demo.

If this looks right, Sophie/Tom — please reply with a quick confirmation and we will mark the MAP as "confirmed" and move LOI + demo scheduling forward. 

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the finish line.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@brightlayer.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP update & confirmation of next steps (signature timeline locked)

Confirmed — LOI sounds fine in principle. Tom and I will review the proposed LOI once Rishi shares it on Mon and confirm back by Wed (Jul 21). We'll also have procurement start the PO routing notice today. Thanks for the clear plan.

— Sophie
